# Musée de l'Armée

> > France's national military museum at Les Invalides, housing collections from medieval armor to WWII, Napoleon's tomb, and cultural programming including concerts and exhibitions.

The Musée de l'Armée preserves French military heritage at the Hôtel des Invalides in Paris. The museum features extensive Napoleonic collections, hosts a musical season at the Cathédrale Saint-Louis des Invalides, and offers venue rentals in historic spaces like the Grand Salon.

## Key Topics

- Napoléon Ier and Napoleonic era
- Dôme des Invalides (Napoleon's tomb)
- Hôtel des Invalides complex
- Military history collections
- Cathédrale Saint-Louis des Invalides
- Musical season and concerts
- Saison Napoléon 2021 bicentennial
- WWII Resistance and Deportation
- Historic battles (Rocroi, Gravelotte, Pavie)
- CERMA research publications
- Venue hire and events
- RMN-Grand Palais partnerships
- Military pageantry and uniforms
- Visitor accessibility
- Cultural programming

## Collections & Exhibitions

- [Les grandes batailles](https://www.musee-armee.fr/collections/explorer-les-collections/portofolios/les-grandes-batailles.html): Historic battles collection: Gravelotte, Pavie, Rhodes, Rocroi artifacts
- [À propos de la saison Napoléon](https://www.musee-armee.fr/au-programme/saison-napoleon-2021/saison-napoleon.html): Napoleon season 2021 bicentennial program at Musée de l'Armée
- [Louis Bissinger (1899-1978)](https://www.musee-armee.fr/actualites/concours-national-de-la-resistance-et-de-la-deportation-2021-2022/louis-bissinger-1899-1978.html): Artist Louis Bissinger: Buchenwald deportation watercolors collection

## Visitor Information

- [Vous êtes](https://www.musee-armee.fr/votre-visite/publics.html): Visitor types guide: groups, families, schools, accessibility info
- [Moyens d'accès](https://www.musee-armee.fr/votre-visite/moyens-dacces.html): Access info: transport, parking, hours for Hôtel des Invalides
- [Café Restaurante Quartier 1670](https://www.musee-armee.fr/es/venir-al-museo/cafe-restaurante-quartier-1670.html): Café Quartier 1670 restaurant at Plaza Vauban entrance (Spanish)

## Venue Hire & Events

- [Grand Drawing Room](https://www.musee-armee.fr/en/venue-hire/grand-drawing-room.html): Grand Drawing Room venue hire for prestigious events at Invalides
- [条款](https://www.musee-armee.fr/zh/%E5%9C%BA%E5%9C%B0%E7%A7%9F%E5%80%9F/%E6%9D%A1%E6%AC%BE.html): Venue rental terms and conditions at Invalides (Chinese)

## Research & Publications

- [Les cahiers d'études et de recherche du musée de l'Armée](https://www.musee-armee.fr/collections/publications-du-musee/les-cahiers-detudes-et-de-recherche-du-musee-de-larmee-cerma.html): CERMA research publications on military history collections
- [Le choc et le chic. Sens et portée de l'apparat militaire](https://www.musee-armee.fr/collections/ressources/conferences-et-colloques-passes/le-choc-et-le-chic.html): Past conference on military pageantry and Napoleon-era elegance
